title: Implement ASRock scraper
description:
Create src/psp_etl/scrape/asrock.py implementing VendorScraper for ASRock.
- Enumerate AM4/AM5 boards from ASRock product pages
- Parse BIOS download links from board support pages
- Download ZIPs, extract raw ROM/BIN
- Predictable CDN URLs (easiest vendor to scrape)
- Depends on: scraper base class
